newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 17.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesady. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan returns home after leading group of Ivorian businessmen on investment promotion tour of South Korea and Japan. Says the two countries are models worth copying.
- New Chief Executive of Air Afrique, Mauritian Sir Harry Tirvegadum, arrives and is received by Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie.
- Discontent spreads: Teachers and pupils protest; taxi drivers on strike.

- Board meeting to approve new chief executive of Air Afrique blocked; now postponed to February 17, 1997. Paper says this is a last minute manoeuvre by outgoing French director-general Yves-Roland Billecart whose contract was not renewed.
- Rubber group SAPH launches work for its fifth rubber factory in Ivory Coast.
- Maritime experts end seminar devoted to ways of improving security of sea cargo.
